conditions: Ciliary Body and Choroid Melanoma, Medium/Large Size

interventions.name: Timing of Anastrozole in respect to radiotherapy
Individualized management of AD including caregiver training
GM-CSF gene transduced allogeneic vaccine GVAX
AZLI 75 mg two times a day (BID)/ three times a day (TID)
